title: Kissed Earthy Spanish Mackerel Ensaimada
description: A pescatarian-friendly Spanish dish featuring mackerel, shio-cure, and earthy flavors in a pillowy ensaimada form, perfect for a quick-fix lunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio cure mix, garlic, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Place the mackerel fillets in a shallow dish and sprinkle the shio cure mix evenly over both sides of the fish.
Let the mackerel cure for 15 minutes.
Roll out the ensaimada dough to a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Place the cured mackerel fillets in the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the fish.
Brush the edges of the dough with olive oil and fold the dough over the fish, pressing gently to seal.
Place the ensaimada on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the top with lemon juice.
Bake the ensaimada for 20 minutes, or until the dough is golden brown and the fish is cooked through.
